question: What publishes THREAD_NATIVE before ScopedJniThreadState runs?
constructor: vm/Jni.cpp:229 calls dvmChangeStatus(mSelf, THREAD_RUNNING) and does not read or require the old status
same_status: vm/Thread.cpp dvmChangeStatus returns the old status without a store when oldStatus == newStatus

startup_on_thread_cpp_outside_authorized.effect_if_used_as_entry: dvmChangeStatus(THREAD_RUNNING) is a same-status return and publishes nothing

production_observed_entry: no Dalvik ThreadStatus word exists on DxExecutionContext or in jni_RegisterNatives
decision: The closed path does not uniquely initialize the entry status. A THREAD_NATIVE default would be an unsupported initial value. Init.cpp and Native.cpp are outside the closed ThreadState file set and are not closed owners.
